_chunk.name: family_system
_chunk.description: Family relationship system schema and household data

_family_schema._desc: Schema for NPC family relationships - applied to all 800 NPCs in npcs_generated.json
_family_schema.spouse_id: NPC ID of spouse, or null if unmarried
_family_schema.parent_ids: Array of NPC IDs for parents (0-2 entries)
_family_schema.sibling_ids: Array of NPC IDs for siblings
_family_schema.children_ids: Array of NPC IDs for children
_family_schema.household_id: Household identifier (HXX format) - NPCs sharing same home

_behavior_integration.celebration_events: Weddings, births trigger happy mood across family
